dimensions.name: Entity Accuracy
dimensions.detail: Extracted document fields compared against CaseInput ground truth.

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.detail: Body paragraph count and prayer presence checked against the plan.

dimensions.name: Structure
dimensions.detail: All 10 required sections from the format spec checked for presence.

dimensions.name: Consistency
dimensions.detail: Respondent number, verification range, and verb-agreement checks.

dimensions.name: Template Fidelity
dimensions.detail: Fixed-phrase reuse, exhibit mapping, and deponent-clause form.

dimensions.name: Hallucination Check
dimensions.detail: Deterministic proxy: years/respondent numbers/exhibit labels in generated prose must trace to case input.

scoring_explanation: Overall score is a weighted average of six dimensions (Entity Accuracy 20%, Completeness 20%, Structure 20%, Consistency 15%, Template Fidelity 15%, Hallucination Check 10%). Each dimension's score is checks_passed / checks_total * 100, where checks come from deterministic comparisons against the case input ground truth and the fixed format spec (see 01_Affidavit_Format_Explained.pdf) — no LLM is involved in scoring.
